server_info: Port, bind address and optional TLS for the shared HTTP server used by all enabled endpoints.
listenPort_help: Local TCP port. Must be reachable from the UniFi controller when the webhook receiver is enabled.
listenIp_help: IP address to bind to. 0.0.0.0 listens on all interfaces.
publicBaseUrl_help: Address under which the controller and browsers reach this HTTP server, e.g. https://iobroker.example.com behind a reverse proxy or port forwarding. Used for the registered webhook URL and all thumbnail and camera URLs. Empty = built from listen IP (or the first network address) and port.
publicBaseUrl_invalid: Expected http(s)://host[:port][/path] — no query, fragment, blanks, user name or password; port 1-65535.
tls_server_info: Enable only if you do not have a TLS-terminating reverse proxy in front. Certificates are taken from the ioBroker certificate store (System settings → Certificates).
enableTls_help: Serve the shared HTTP endpoint over HTTPS. If the selected certificates cannot be loaded, the server is not started (no fall-back to plain http) and the reason is reported in the log.
controllerHost_help: IP address or hostname of your UniFi Access controller (UA Ultra in standalone mode, or any host running UniFi Access).
apiToken_help: Generate a token in the UniFi Access UI under Access → Settings → General → Advanced → API Token.
verifyTLS_help: Disabled by default — UniFi Access uses a self-signed certificate that does not validate by default.
caCert_help: Optional. PEM text of the CA certificate of the console (several certificates allowed). Trusted in addition to the system CAs when "Verify TLS certificate" is on here or on the Protect tab.
wsReconnectDelay_help: Maximum back-off delay between WebSocket reconnect attempts.
doorbell_info: Incoming doorbell calls are shown passively. Accepting/rejecting calls requires WebRTC, which is not part of this adapter — use the official UniFi Access app for that.
defaultUnlockDuration_help: 0 sends a momentary unlock pulse via /doors/:id/unlock. Any value > 0 keeps the door unlocked for that many minutes via /doors/:id/lock_rule type=custom (the API only accepts whole minutes).
enableWebhooks_help: Activates additional door, sensor, schedule and visitor events via webhook.
reregisterWebhook_help: Deletes the current webhook endpoint on the controller and recreates it with a fresh secret. Use this if you see "signature verification failed" warnings.
reregisterWebhook_error_not_configured: Webhook cannot be registered: the running instance has no controller host or API token. Enter both, save and try again.
reregisterWebhook_error_webhooks_disable: Webhook cannot be registered: the webhook receiver is not enabled in the running instance. Enable it, save the settings and try again.
reregisterWebhook_error_receiver_not_run: Webhook cannot be registered: the HTTP server of the adapter is not running or no usable network address was found. Check listen port and listen IP and the log of the instance.
reregisterWebhook_error_unknown_command: The running adapter instance does not know this command. Adapter and settings page seem to have different versions — restart the instance.
enableThumbnailServer_help: Serves the latest event thumbnail per device as a JPEG. Used by the www panel.
events_info: Forward selected UniFi Access events to arbitrary ioBroker states. Leave empty to use only the built-in event states. Webhook-only events require the webhook receiver to be enabled.
generic_webhook_info: HTTP endpoint for the UniFi Alarm Manager. Receives POST requests from the UniFi Alarm Manager on the shared HTTP server and writes the payload to an ioBroker state.
enableGenericWebhook_help: Accepts POST requests from the Alarm Manager on the shared HTTP server (see HTTP server tab) under the path configured below.
genericWebhookPath_help: URL path the receiver accepts requests on.
genericWebhookPath_invalid: Only letters, digits and . _ ~ - separated by single slashes, e.g. /webhook or /alarm/door. /unifi-access-webhook and paths below /unifi-access/ are used by the adapter itself.
protect_info: Connects to the UniFi Protect controller (UCG Max) to automatically fetch a camera snapshot on door events. The snapshot is shown as a thumbnail in the www panel event log. Credentials: local admin user of the Protect controller (same host as Access, port 443).
protect_verify_tls_help: Disabled by default — UniFi consoles use a self-signed certificate. Enable only if the console has a certificate that is valid or can be verified with a CA certificate.
unlockActor_note: The unlock actor only applies to the pulse unlock (unlock with a default unlock duration of 0). Timed unlocks (default unlock duration > 0, unlock_duration) and lock rules go through the lock rule API, which knows no actor — UniFi logs them under the name of the API token.
